title: Replaces the generic fraud rejection reason with specific fraud reasons
changed: accounts.reject reason changed from string to an enum without fraud (fraud_* values and credit added)
reason: Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.
